import html # Example template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Response
{user_content}
""" def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generates an HTML page by embedding escaped user content into a template. Args: user_content (str): The raw content supplied by the user. Returns: str: A complete HTML page with the escaped user content inserted. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection attacks. safe_content = html.escape(user_content) # Render the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
